research_question: Does the state policy change missed-train / premature-opening outcomes vs stateless fusion?

inputs: 27-event B2 caches incl back camera (after Stage 1 assembly fix)
method: Paired cache replay on identical inputs

acceptance_criteria: Pilot (5 events) completes with full audit trail; results reported as change with uncertainty

inputs: Same caches front-only vs dual conditions
required_ground_truth: Same as EXP-01 + accepted sync or 11-event scope
acceptance_criteria: Conditions differ by exactly one component
